capabilities: Shows a dashboard of tasks, tickets, time and recent activity
Tracks active time per category with a workday timer and daily log notes
Manages tickets with steps, due dates, reminders and PDF export
Collects tasks from tagged notes, the daily note and a global list
Adds writing aids such as a table picker, slash menu and lockable callouts
disambiguation: Not a slides or presentation tool; "deck" here means a dashboard of switchable modules.
extras: Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.5.0+; the six modules can each be switched off in settings; a copy of settings and data is kept in .obsidian/neon-deck-data/ and restored if the plugin folder is replaced.
problem: Obsidian has no single place to see tasks, tickets, tracked time and study material together, so users have to combine several separate plugins.
summary: Local-only workspace plugin bundling a dashboard, tasks, tickets, automatic time tracking, study notes and writing tools in one themed interface.
